parsed.rationale: All four members are `type-alias-object` declarations in `app:iOS` under `WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingWidget/Views/`, and the cluster reports `shared_field_count: 2` with `differing_slots: null` and `jaccard: null`. Because these are type aliases rather than concrete types, the structural similarity is almost certainly a consequence of each alias resolving to the same underlying SwiftUI view type (e.g., `NowPlayingWidgetEntryView`) with a size/layout discriminator — a standard WidgetKit pattern where `SmallNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, `MediumNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, and `LargeNowPlayingWidgetEntryView` are intentionally distinct names required by the widget configuration API. Collapsing them would break the widget family registration surface without any meaningful reduction in code. `Header` is a separate UI component whose coincidental alias shape does not imply shared semantics with the widget entry views.
